method: Direct inspection of all eight original full-page PNG captures; no recapture or image modification.

scope.fonts: system Arial and Georgia in the isolated rendering fixture

observations: Single-column layout fits the 390-pixel viewport.
Labels, reviewed text, date field and explicit confirm/discard controls remain visible and wrap within their card.
The focused date field has a visible outline; form and plan cards remain separate.
The original draft day 3 and current pending day 4 are both visible.
Entered text is retained; context-check and acknowledgement controls wrap without clipping.
Save is visibly disabled before context acknowledgement.
An uncertain write shows the retry of the same request as the active primary control.
A newer reply leaves the prior draft visible and disabled; there is no success claim.
Error, recovery explanation and preserved inputs remain within the narrow column.
The resolved form is replaced by a compact receipt.
Receipt wording identifies confirmation of an earlier saved adjustment for day 4, with the action and chosen date visible.
The following reviewed-plan card stays separate and readable.
Two-column layout remains aligned and the chat card ends at its own content height.
Action editor controls have clear labels and a visible date focus outline.
Confirm/discard controls fit together without crowding or overflow.
Original day 3 and current day 4 are distinguished before reconfirmation.
The personal draft is retained and the confirmation control is disabled.
The long conversation uses its bounded scroll area; no horizontal overflow or overlapping controls is visible.
The retry control is prominent while mutation and discard controls are disabled.
The newer-reply notice does not replace the preserved draft or claim a successful write.
The independent chat card does not stretch to the entire sidebar height.
A compact receipt replaces the editor after recovery.
The previous-save confirmation, current day and chosen review date are readable.
Chat, canonical next action and reviewed-plan sections remain distinct, without overlap or clipped controls.

automatedEvidence.contrastLimitation: All eight axe audits retain incomplete color-contrast results on gradient backgrounds. This visual review does not turn them into measured contrast passes.

limitations: 390×844 is a desktop Chromium viewport, not a physical phone or touch test.
This review does not verify Safari, browser locale differences, real Auth, persistence, RLS, hosted deployment or model responses.
The actual database integration and full application-shell screenshots require their separate CI evidence.
